title: Change of use

blocks.html: Such use may be changed to a conforming use and in appropriate cases the authorizing agency may permit such use to be changed to another non-conforming use which would be permitted under the provisions applicable to non-conforming uses as set forth in Sections 52-31 to 52-36, inclusive, relating to Change of Non-Conforming Use, provided that the authorizing agency finds that such change of use will not impair the essential character or the future use or development of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: Such use may be changed to a conforming use and in appropriate cases the authorizing agency may permit such use to be changed to another non-conforming use which would be permitted under the provisions applicable to non-conforming uses as set forth in Sections 52-31 to 52-36, inclusive, relating to Change of Non-Conforming Use, provided that the authorizing agency finds that such change of use will not impair the essential character or the future use or development of the surrounding area.

blocks.html: In permitting a change to another non-conforming use, such authorizing agency may impose appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize any adverse effects upon the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: In permitting a change to another non-conforming use, such authorizing agency may impose appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize any adverse effects upon the character of the surrounding area.

blocks.html: For the purposes of this Section, a change of use is a change to another use listed in the same or any other Use Group.  A change in ownership or occupancy shall not, by itself, constitute a change of use.
blocks.plainText: For the purposes of this Section, a change of use is a change to another use listed in the same or any other Use Group. A change in ownership or occupancy shall not, by itself, constitute a change of use.
